candidate.blueprint_locator: Management of Care → Assignment, Delegation and Supervision, printed p.20 / PDF p.24
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — Delegation supervision and evaluation
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize that the RN retains responsibility for supervision and evaluation after appropriately delegating a client-care task.

options.A: Supervise and evaluate whether the delegated task was completed correctly
options.B: Transfer all responsibility for the client's care to the staff member who accepted the task
options.C: Avoid reviewing the task unless the staff member reports an error
options.D: Assume completion is correct once the task has been assigned

candidate.rationale: The 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan includes the rights of delegation, including right supervision/evaluation, and directs the RN to evaluate delegated tasks to ensure correct completion. Appropriate delegation does not eliminate the RN's responsibility to supervise and evaluate the delegated care. Therefore A is the best answer.
candidate.source_claim_supported: After delegation, the RN is expected to supervise/evaluate the delegated activity and ensure correct completion.
candidate.source_locator: Detailed Test Plan, Management of Care → Assignment, Delegation and Supervision, printed p.20 / PDF p.24: utilize the rights of delegation including right supervision/evaluation; evaluate delegated tasks to ensure correct completion of activity
candidate.source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
candidate.stem: After the RN appropriately delegates a client-care task to another staff member, which responsibility remains with the RN?
